subject: Work stress tracked persistent sleep problems in 70% of over-50s
script: From Agewell Brief: Work stress tracked persistent sleep problems in 70% of over-50s. A new study finds that work-related stress is associated with significant sleep disturbances in people over 50, with many experiencing persistent issues. Nearly 70% of participants had persistent, clinically significant sleep problems. Almost 92% met the threshold for a sleep disorder at least once. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
